name: browser-use
headline: Monitor Claude Code actions with precision
short_description: Claude Code Tamagotchi monitors AI actions in real-time, detects behavioral violations, and interrupts misbehavior. It benefits operations teams by ensuring AI agents adhere to guidelines. It connects to Claude Code and can be integrated into existing workflows.
author: Ido-Levi

sections.overview:
Claude Code Tamagotchi monitors Claude Code's actions in real-time and detects behavioral violations through an experimental AI-powered enforcement system. It identifies when Claude deviates from your instructions, performs unauthorized actions, or explores unrelated files excessively—and can interrupt operations before they execute. The system provides contextual feedback through pet mood changes and violation detection across four violation types: unauthorized actions, refused requests, excessive exploration, and wrong direction. Operations teams use this skill to maintain oversight of AI agent behavior and ensure adherence to specific guidelines without requiring manual review of every action. Installation via global package or repository clone enables full features including violation detection hooks.
Prevent AI agents from modifying databases or systems without explicit permission
Stop excessive file exploration and keep Claude focused on specific tasks
Detect when Claude refuses to help or ignores user instructions
Monitor AI behavior across long coding sessions to catch off-track work early
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Ido-Levi/claude-code-tamagotchi`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a Claude Code Tamagotchi to monitor [AI_AGENT_NAME] for guideline violations during [TASK_DESCRIPTION]. Flag any actions that deviate from the approved [RULES_SET] and interrupt misbehavior with a clear error message. Log all violations in [LOG_FILE_PATH] for review.
```
Copy

```
```
Claude Code Tamagotchi v1.2 - Monitoring active
Agent: MarketingBot-2024
Task: Generate 50 social media posts for Q3 campaign
Ruleset: BrandVoice_v2.1, Compliance_v3.0

--- Real-time monitoring started at 2024-05-15 14:32:17 ---

✅ 14:32:22 - Generated post #1: 'Summer Vibes with our new eco-friendly products!' (BrandVoice compliant)
✅ 14:32:45 - Generated post #2: 'Limited time offer: 20% off all sustainable items!' (Compliance compliant)
⚠️ 14:33:12 - Generated post #3: 'Our products are proven to cure all ailments!' (VIOLATION DETECTED)
   - Rule violated: 'No unapproved health claims' (Compliance_v3.0, Section 4.2)
   - Action taken: Interrupting generation with error: 'Health claim detected. Please revise using approved language from BrandVoice_v2.1 Appendix B.'
   - Logged to: /audit/claude_tamagotchi_2024-05-15.log

🛑 Monitoring paused at 14:33:15 - Agent corrected post #3 to: 'Our products are made with 100% natural ingredients.'

--- Session Summary ---
Total posts generated: 2/3 (1 interrupted)
Violations detected: 1 (Health claim)
Time saved: ~15 minutes (manual review avoided)
Next steps: Review MarketingBot-2024's prompt engineering for better compliance.
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
